This is the personal website of **LUO Qun (罗群)**.

## Visiting the website

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. Hosting providers may process request information to serve pages and maintain their services. This version of the site does not load Google Analytics.

## Subscriptions and comments

The optional subscription form sends your email address to the site's subscription service. A confirmation email is used to verify your subscription. The comment form sends your chosen name and comment text to the site's comment service. Approved comments may appear publicly, so please avoid including private information in a comment.

These features use Supabase and Cloudflare Turnstile. Turnstile checks help protect submissions from spam. On blog pages, a browser-local identifier is stored for the interaction features.

You can read the providers' information at [GitHub](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement), [Supabase](https://supabase.com/privacy), and [Cloudflare](https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/).

## Contact

For questions about your subscription, comments, or data, email [qunluo.kiwi@gmail.com](mailto:qunluo.kiwi@gmail.com).
